title: Right-click play: a toy queue (punching bag, ball) and a cotton bed when he sleeps
description: Fabio 2026-11-26: cookies alone are too thin a game. Right-click gives him a toy; the next right-click swaps it for the next toy; he plays a few seconds or until something else happens. Punching bag on a pole (he head-butts it, it swings back and sometimes hits him, he gets upset, then keeps hitting with focused eyes) and a little ball. Asleep, a right-click gives him a fluffy white cotton bed: comfy, happy eyes, sleeps on. Right-click is told apart with SMIL begin=strip.contextmenu (research/mods-api.md, 2026-11-26).
